attributes.action: Call for an immediate general election
attributes.background: Due to the resignation of Sir Keir Starmer, I think it is only fair that the public decide on who they see fit to be their prime minister, not only to better our country but to put its people first and regain the trust of its leaders

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
